item.description:
Dax 3.9.6

  • Schedules run at the right time in your time zone. Dax now reads the Mac’s own zone, so a schedule set for 2:57 PM runs at 2:57 PM, and Settings › Schedules › Time zone lets you pick another.
  • Each scheduled run saves what happened as a transcript: every message and each tool call. Open it from the run’s row or its end card.
  • New option: close the tab when a scheduled run finishes. It never closes a tab you’re looking at, and only closes once the transcript is saved.
